summary.en: The Mods page loads faster. The mod catalog is now split into one small file per mod, and the launcher downloads again only the mods that changed since your last visit.
summary.pt-BR: A página de Mods carrega mais rápido. O catálogo de mods agora é dividido em um arquivo pequeno por mod, e o launcher só baixa de novo os mods que mudaram desde a sua última visita.

summary.en: Infinity Horizon is out of beta: no more BETA labels, badge or notice in the launcher.
summary.pt-BR: O Infinity Horizon saiu do beta: os rótulos, o selo e o aviso BETA saíram do launcher.

summary.en: FM5 joins Infinity! For now it's private matches between friends only.
summary.pt-BR: O FM5 chegou ao Infinity! Por enquanto, apenas partidas privadas entre amigos.

summary.en: Infected alone. An Infected event with only one player ends when the race starts, never during the countdown.

summary.en: King: a second round crowns again. A second King or Infected in the same lobby now starts with a crowned car (or patient zero) and keeps the event's rules and car restrictions.
